purpose: Keep the technological hypothesis testable without relabeling mythic language as machinery. Score explicit procedure and apparatus features separately and calibrate against actual Egyptian medical writing.

feature_codebook.P1_EXPLICIT_INJURY_OR_DEFECT: A bodily defect/loss is directly stated.
feature_codebook.P2_EXPLICIT_OPERATOR: A named agent performs the intervention.
feature_codebook.P3_NAMED_PHYSICAL_TOOL: A physical implement is explicitly used in the relevant operation.
feature_codebook.P4_NAMED_MATERIAL_OR_REAGENT: A physical treatment material is explicitly applied.
feature_codebook.P5_ORDERED_STEPS: The witness gives a recoverable action order rather than only a result.
feature_codebook.P6_POST_TREATMENT_CHECK_OR_OUTCOME: Healing/regrowth/restored state is explicitly checked or stated.
feature_codebook.P7_EXPLICIT_RETRIEVAL: A lost part is physically sought/found/retrieved.
feature_codebook.P8_EXPLICIT_REGROWTH_OR_REINTEGRATION: The part is explicitly regrown, reattached, filled, healed or returned to place/function.
feature_codebook.P9_MEASURED_DOSE_TIME_OR_QUANTITY: Treatment uses explicit quantitative dosing, duration or repeat schedule relevant to the intervention.
feature_codebook.A1_ENCLOSURE_OR_TREATMENT_CHAMBER: A stable chamber/capsule/enclosure is explicitly part of treatment.
feature_codebook.A2_STABLE_APPARATUS_IDENTITY: The same named treatment apparatus recurs across independent witnesses.
feature_codebook.A3_ENERGY_OR_ACTIVATION_SYSTEM: An explicit energy source or device activation mechanism is described.
feature_codebook.A4_INSTRUMENTATION_OR_MEASUREMENT: An apparatus measures or monitors bodily state.
feature_codebook.A5_CONSTRUCTION_OR_COMPONENT_SPECIFICATI: The treatment device has a build/material/component specification.
feature_codebook.A6_NON_MYTHIC_MECHANICAL_CAUSATION: The restoration is explained through an unambiguous physical mechanism rather than divine agency alone.

CT158_BD113_HANDS_ARMS.notes: The snare is a retrieval implement, not a regeneration device. Month/Half-month wording is not counted as treatment duration.

CHESTER_BEATTY_I_EYES_HATHOR.notes: This is the strongest procedure-like Horus healing witness in the pilot: remove-eye injury, gazelle-milk reagent, right/left application, eye opening, and verification of healed state.

BD17_CT335_WEDJAT_THOTH.notes: Fingers are counted as an explicit treatment implement; spittle is present in a variant gloss. No machine-like apparatus is described.

EGYPTIAN_MEDICAL_WRITING_POSITIVE_CONTRO.observation: UCL describes Egyptian healing manuscripts as explicitly separating prognosis/diagnosis, prescription and incantation. The Edwin Smith example gives examination, diagnosis, emergency treatment, materials, daily treatment, second examination and second treatment. Precision of ingredients and quantities is specifically noted as important in prescription collections.
EGYPTIAN_MEDICAL_WRITING_POSITIVE_CONTRO.importance: Ancient Egyptian writers were capable of recording technical treatment sequences with concrete ingredients, repeated schedules and reassessment. Therefore the absence of apparatus construction/activation/measurement language in the Horus restoration witnesses is informative rather than something that must automatically be blamed on Egyptian writing style.

KAHUN_QUANTITATIVE_RECIPE_CONTROL.observation: The Kahun medical text contains explicit measures, ingredients, boiling/cooling/mixing and treatment over specified numbers of mornings in multiple prescriptions.
KAHUN_QUANTITATIVE_RECIPE_CONTROL.importance: Provides a direct control for what quantitative procedural specificity can look like in Egyptian texts.

BD99_SEMANTIC_MAPPING_NEGATIVE_CONTROL.observation: Divine/body names can be assigned to parts of a boat without converting those names into literal biological or technological components.

APPARATUS_CANDIDATE_MINIMUM: At least three independently transmitted witnesses must share the same apparatus-like feature bundle.
At least one of A1, A2, A3, A4 or A5 must be explicit in each supporting witness; P-features alone cannot trigger an apparatus claim.
The proposed apparatus term must survive comparison with medical/ritual procedural controls and semantic-mapping controls.
A device claim remains blocked if the shared structure can be explained solely by divine-agent narrative roles plus ordinary tools/reagents.

highest_admissible_claim: The Horus corpus contains genuinely procedure-like restoration narratives, including retrieval tools, treatment reagents, ordered actions, regrowth/healing, and outcome checking. In the current pilot, however, none of the three direct restoration witnesses contains an explicit chamber, stable treatment apparatus, energy/activation system, instrumentation, construction specification, or repeated machine identity. The regenerative-device hypothesis therefore remains testable but unsupported at this gate.
